description:
Certify a purchase order: return a Schnorr-signed Nostr event certificate.

The paid_tool decorator handles the ad valorem fee debit and stores
the cost in runtime._last_debit_cost. No recomputation needed.

Called by operator MCP servers (not end users) when a patron purchases credits.

amount_sats.description: The total purchase amount in satoshis. Must be positive.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The operator's DPYC npub (from register_operator response).

name: authority_certify_credits
title: Certify credits
